Contains: pub type Cycles = u64; Z80_HZ = 3_072_000; CYCLES_PER_LINE = 192; LINES_PER_FRAME = 264; CYCLES_PER_FRAME = 50_688 (all typed as Cycles/u64); plus HSYNC_HZ = 16_000, PIXELS_PER_LINE = 384, PIXELS_PER_CYCLE = 2 encoding 'pixel = 2 cycles'.
